verdict.rationale: INPI's own homepage links a "Guia de pedido online de marcas e logótipos" (online application guide for trademarks and logos), which supports that its core filing transaction can be done online. It also states that title issuance can be requested online. The other pages describe patent, utility-model and design applications without stating the filing channel. missing for 10: explicit statement that patent/utility model/design applications can be filed online, evidence of online fee payment, detailed description of the online filing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
